note: Exact rounded live-block occupancy and available block-slot capacity from mi_subproc_visit_heaps/mi_heap_visit_blocks at naturally global-idle scheduler points. Main thread only, scheduler mutex held, no progress animator. Callbacks do not allocate. All worker allocations/frees finish before activeWorkers reaches zero. Slots equal page.capacity * full_block_size, not OS commit; page metadata/tails, unused arena slices and proximity/mappings are outside the page totals. Occupied includes size-class rounding and padding; it is not requested or useful bytes. Snapshot RSS comes from mi_process_info at the same global-idle point; the process peak can occur between snapshots.

measurement.timing_note: Global-idle mimalloc page traversal; excluded from speed comparisons. Read-only traversal subtracts pending remote frees without collecting or purging.

diagnostic_visitor_note: The normal visitor aborts on an ownership assertion in _mi_page_update_sample_countdown while collecting a page. The frozen diagnostic adds a scoped read-only visitor branch: initialize the area, count its pending xthread_free linked list using mimalloc decoding, subtract that count from area.used, and invoke the callback. The scheduler mutex excludes workers; no metadata/free list/ownership/statistics is modified by this branch. The temporary vendor and JobManager changes were restored after freezing the binary.

large_bin_candidate.note: Observed occupancy, not a predicted or measured saving. MI_ENABLE_LARGE_PAGES=0 removes 4 MiB regular pages for this range; singleton rounding, metadata, purge behavior and allocation time still require comparison.
